name: Birds

variantInfo.name: Chicken
notes: The Chicken has 3 Hitpoints, max hit 0 (it barely fights back), and gives 3 Slayer XP; it is the most efficient bird to kill.
Sixteen bird types count for the task (Chickens, Ducks, Seagulls, Penguins, Terrorbirds, Vultures, Chompy birds, Baby Roc, etc.); most drop only bones or nothing.

locationComparison.name: Bird spawns (various)
notes: Chickens and ducks cluster in Lumbridge/Falador farms; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Every bird spawn on the wiki location table is single-way, cannonable, and safespottable.
Birds drop feathers, bones or nothing, so the task is a starter Slayer-XP task.

taskNotes: Birds are assigned by Turael and Spria (Spria after completing A Porcine of Interest); there is no combat, Slayer, or quest requirement to be assigned.
slayerTargetId 277 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Sixteen bird types count, from level-1 Chickens and Ducks to the level-75 Baby Roc; only the representative Chicken is authored as the default variant, the rest are honest-UNKNOWN here.
The Chicken has 3 Hitpoints, max hit 0, 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 1 (strongly negative defence bonuses).
Birds have no elemental weakness; any melee weapon clears them.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Birds.
recommendedMethod: A trivial low-level Slayer-XP task: kill Chickens (the most efficient bird) or any other counted bird with any weapon. Birds have negligible Defence and barely fight back, so no food or special gear is needed; the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak.
